opportunities.name: Armor aftershock boxer
opportunities.objective: Test armor aftershock boxer against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Thunderclap's attack and five-second aftershocks scale with 0.15 armor as physical damage, while Ground Slam scales 0.4 armor as magic. Iceborn adds physical Spellblade and a slow zone; Terminus helps mixed attack damage if Malphite can remain in melee.
opportunities.requiredState: Granite Shield active for the larger passive armor multiplier.
opportunities.failure: Magic opponents bypass the armor focus and poke removes the tripled W bonus.
opportunities.test: Measure W attacks and E before and after shield breaks.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Armor does not give AP to Q/R and aftershocks cannot be assumed to crit.

opportunities.name: Hybrid armor AP punch
opportunities.objective: Test hybrid armor ap punch against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Thunderclap also carries AP ratios on its empowered attack and physical aftershocks, while E has 0.6 AP magic scaling. Nashor and Dusk and Dawn test the five-second W attack window after R; Randuin adds armor that supports W/E and buys melee survival.
opportunities.requiredState: R connects and target stays within W attacks.
opportunities.failure: Lower penetration or attack access loses the conventional R burst.
opportunities.test: Compare three W attacks plus E against a full AP burst at equal gold.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: AP ratios do not change W's physical damage type; Spellblade is a separate magic packet.

ruledOut.reason: Armor does not give AP to Q/R and aftershocks cannot be assumed to crit.

unknowns: Controlled current-patch proc testing remains necessary; source helper/statFormula expressions are evidence, not confirmed runtime behavior.

builds.name: Armor aftershock boxer
builds.summary: Test armor aftershock boxer against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test armor aftershock boxer against conventional damage at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: Thunderclap's attack and five-second aftershocks scale with 0.15 armor as physical damage, while Ground Slam scales 0.4 armor as magic. Iceborn adds physical Spellblade and a slow zone; Terminus helps mixed attack damage if Malphite can remain in melee.
testPlan: Required state: Granite Shield active for the larger passive armor multiplier.
Measure W attacks and E before and after shield breaks.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Magic opponents bypass the armor focus and poke removes the tripled W bonus.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Armor does not give AP to Q/R and aftershocks cannot be assumed to crit.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Frozen Heart, Iceborn Gauntlet, Sunfire Aegis, Terminus, Spirit Visage, Plated Steelcaps. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
